title: Step 4 - UCB Algorithm Performance: Analyzing Ad Selection with Histograms

cues.en: -: Hello and welcome to this art tutorial.
cues.zh: 講師：大家好，歡迎來到 R 教學。

cues.en: So in the previous tutorial, we got the exciting result of the total reward being 2,178 and therefore almost doubling the total reward we get
cues.zh: 上一堂得到精彩結果，總獎勵 2,178，幾乎是

cues.en: with the random selection algorithm, which was around 1,200.
cues.zh: 隨機選擇約 1,200 的兩倍。

cues.en: So that was the first exciting result.
cues.zh: 這是第一個精彩結果。

cues.en: And we also got another exciting results, which was the best ad to show to the user given by this ad selected vector
cues.zh: 還有另一個，從 ads_selected 向量得知最佳廣告，

cues.en: by looking at the last rounds here containing only fives That showed us that the ad was the highest conversion rates is the version number five of the ad.
cues.zh: 看最後回合全是 5，顯示轉換率最高的是第五版。

cues.en: So two exciting results.
cues.zh: 兩個精彩結果。

cues.en: And now to finish this section even better, we will have a look at the histogram to have a quick look at the overall strategy to see the number of times each ad was selected
cues.zh: 最後為了更完整結束這個單元，看看長條分布圖，快速了解整體策略、每個廣告選取次數，

cues.en: and how the selections of ad number five dominate the selections of the other ad.
cues.zh: 以及第五個如何壓倒其他廣告。

cues.en: So that's gonna be very quick and easy because we simply need to use hist, which is right here, enter.
cues.zh: 非常快也很簡單，只要用 hist，就在這裡，Enter。

cues.en: And now as input, we simply need to get the variable that contains the values we want to plot on this histogram.
cues.zh: 輸入只需要包含想在圖上呈現數值的變數。

cues.en: And that's of course the ads selected vector because you know this vector tells us which ad was selected at each round.
cues.zh: 當然是 ads_selected 向量，因為記錄每回合選了哪個。

cues.en: And so this histogram method here will look at the number of times each ad was selected in this ad selected vector and that will plot the histogram.
cues.zh: hist 方法會計算這個向量中每個廣告被選幾次，再畫出圖。

cues.en: So basically we're done.
cues.zh: 基本上完成了。

cues.en: And now just to make it better, we can add a color.
cues.zh: 為了更好，可以加顏色。

cues.en: So we type col equals blue in quotes if of course we want the blue color.
cues.zh: 如果想要藍色，輸入 col = "blue"。

cues.en: And then add a title by adding this main equals.
cues.zh: 再用 main 等於，加上標題。

cues.en: And then in quotes we add a title.
cues.zh: 引號裡輸入標題。

cues.en: And so let's say histogram of ad selections.
cues.zh: 例如「廣告選取次數分布」。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: And we can also add a label to the x axis.
cues.zh: 也能加 X 軸標籤。

cues.en: So same we use in quotes, we add here ad, right?
cues.zh: 一樣加引號，這裡填「廣告」。

cues.en: Because you know, basically what we'll have on the X axis are gonna be the labels of the ads.
cues.zh: 因為 X 軸基本上就是廣告標籤。

cues.en: So that's why I'm adding here ads.
cues.zh: 所以這裡加「廣告」。

cues.en: And of course let's add a Y label, quotes, and let's say number of times each ad was selected.
cues.zh: 當然也加 Y 軸標籤，引號內寫「每個廣告被選取的次數」。

cues.en: Great.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: And basically we're done.
cues.zh: 完成。

cues.en: So now let's have a look.
cues.zh: 現在看看。

cues.en: We will select this code section here and press commander control plus enter to execute.
cues.zh: 選取這個區段，按 Command 或 Ctrl 加 Enter 執行。

cues.en: And here is the histogram.
cues.zh: 這就是分布圖。

cues.en: And wow, we can clearly see that the ad number five is the ad that was most selected by the users.
cues.zh: 哇，明顯看到第五個廣告被選最多。

cues.en: That is the ad that has the highest conversion rate and therefore no doubt, that's the ad we need to show to our users for the marketing campaigns of this cheap, brand new luxury SUV.
cues.zh: 也就是轉換率最高，所以毫無疑問，這台便宜、全新豪華 SUV 的行銷活動，應該顯示這個廣告。

cues.en: So no doubt, the fifth ad, wonderful.
cues.zh: 毫無疑問，第五個，很棒。

cues.en: We completed our job as a machine learning scientist and so congratulations we implemented a great algorithm.
cues.zh: 完成機器學習科學家的工作，恭喜，實作了很棒的演算法。

cues.en: So now what we'll do is implement another algorithm to see if we can do better.
cues.zh: 現在再實作另一個，看看能否更好。

cues.en: And this other algorithm will be Thompson Sampling algorithm.
cues.zh: 也就是 Thompson 抽樣。

cues.en: So let's see if Thompson Sampling can beat UCB and we'll find out in the next section.
cues.zh: 看看它能否勝過 UCB，下一單元揭曉。

cues.en: Until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，祝你享受機器學習的樂趣。
